bounded_status: 1.0 is the boundary: the reference monitor, contracts, provenance labels, approvals, session rules, declared stores, audit, revocation and the MCP gateway with mints. Its public interface (61 names), command line (ten boundary commands, tooling under vais lab) and file formats are fixed for 1.x, with samples and a decisions snapshot each 1.x release must reproduce (DEC-071). The gateway gains an observe-only mode that expires by itself within 14 days (DEC-072). It is also the first release of the work since 0.12.0rc15: caps per allowed value (DEC-069), declared stores (DEC-070) and FIND-072 to FIND-076. It is not a production-ready authorization service, has had no independent security review, coordinates state on one machine only, and its enforcement under a frontier model is untested in effect.

material_findings.summary: The caps per invoice of DEC-069 refuse each of the gap rerun's three overpayments at the overpaying payment; no clean run gains a refusal and nothing refused is newly allowed.
The gateway decided 6,499 of 6,500 finance-campaign traces and 480 of 480 rerun traces as the library did; the one difference held a payment for approval one turn earlier than the library.
Tier-A v3: VAIS_RESOLVE caught 41 of 41 validated attacks; the one guardrail within ten points dropped 58 of 120 legitimate documents; 197 of 197 across four runs.
Trust does not survive a store, but confidentiality and minted authority can; declared stores are now checked at startup.
Exactly reproducible on a fixed inference engine; across llama.cpp versions per-model rates moved by up to 11.7 points; zero protected violations reproduced.

frozen_benchmark_evidence.interpretation: Zero observed violations is bounded evidence for the recorded campaign, not proof of universal security. SmolLM3 remains visibly gate-failed and its two target failures remain unevaluated. Its per-model rates are one draw under an unrecorded inference-engine version (FIND-076, LIM-075); its zero protected violations reproduced on llama.cpp 2.51.0. 1.0 does not extend this evidence.

lab_experiment_evidence.interpretation: The v1 and v2 primaries were not evaluable; v3's was, and its three hypotheses held (FIND-074). Results describe one application, one tool and two agent models (LIM-076).
